summary: Example ad-hoc command gathering facts from all hosts and saving them per hostname under /tmp/facts with --tree.
questions: How do I dump facts from all hosts to files?
How do I save gathered facts by hostname?

answer_card.title: Save facts for all hosts to files
answer_card.answer_md:
```
ansible all -m ansible.builtin.gather_facts --tree /tmp/facts
```
Stores each host's facts in `/tmp/facts/<hostname>`.
